# Vendored Leaflet 1.9.4

`leaflet.js` and `leaflet.css` are Leaflet 1.9.4 (`dist/leaflet.js` and
`dist/leaflet.css` from the npm package), unchanged. They are built into
each run's map when it is written with `--offline`, so the page works without an
internet connection. Leaflet is under the BSD 2-Clause License; see
`LEAFLET_LICENSE`.

Subresource integrity hashes, matching those Leaflet publishes:

- `leaflet.js`: `sha256-20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=`
- `leaflet.css`: `sha256-p4NxAoJBhIIN+hmNHrzRCf9tD/miZyoHS5obTRR9BMY=`
